scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:feature
scripts.test: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:ui:run && npm run test:accessibility:run && npm run test:api:run
scripts.test:ui: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:ui:run
scripts.test:ui:run: npx bddgen --config playwright.ui.config.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.ui.config.ts
scripts.test:accessibility: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:accessibility:run
scripts.test:accessibility:run: npx bddgen --config playwright.accessibility.config.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.accessibility.config.ts
scripts.test:api: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:api:run
scripts.test:api:run: npx bddgen --config playwrightapi.config.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwrightapi.config.ts
scripts.allure-report: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.allure:ui: allure generate reports/ui/allure-results --clean -o reports/ui/allure-report && allure open reports/ui/allure-report
scripts.allure:accessibility: allure generate reports/accessibility/allure-results --clean -o reports/accessibility/allure-report && allure open reports/accessibility/allure-report
scripts.allure:api: allure generate reports/api/allure-results --clean -o reports/api/allure-report && allure open reports/api/allure-report
